texts.title: 课文一：我看了一个电影
texts.setting: 白家月和陈天中在谈论上一次课外旅行。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 你们上火车后看见王老师了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen shàng huǒchē hòu kànjiàn Wáng lǎoshī le ma?
lines.english: Did you see Ms. Wang after boarding the train?

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.hanzi: 没看见。中午车开后，有些人看书，有些人睡觉了。
lines.pinyin: Méi kànjiàn. Zhōngwǔ chē kāi hòu, yǒu xiē rén kàn shū, yǒu xiē rén shuìjiào le.
lines.english: No. After the train departed at noon, some were reading and some fell asleep.

texts.title: 课文二：都会写了
texts.setting: 在课堂上，王一飞询问同学们的学习情况。

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 你们会说汉语了，也会写汉字了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen huì shuō Hànyǔ le, yě huì xiě Hànzì le ma?
lines.english: You can speak Chinese now. Can you also write Chinese characters?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.english: We can all write them now.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.hanzi: 请大家不要说话！请听老师的问题：你们都会写哪些汉字了？
lines.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā búyào shuōhuà! Qǐng tīng lǎoshī de wèntí: Nǐmen dōu huì xiě nǎxiē Hànzì le?
lines.english: Please stop talking. Listen to my question: Which Chinese characters can you write?

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiě zhèxiē zì le, nín kàn!
lines.english: I can write these characters now. Look!
